title: TGA (Targa) image signature
summary: A TGA file has no magic number at the start. The footer (last 26 bytes) contains the signature 'TRUEVISION-XFILE.\0' (0x54 0x52 0x55 0x45 0x56 0x49 0x53 0x49 0x4F 0x4E 0x2D 0x58 0x46 0x49 0x4C 0x45 0x2E 0x00) at offset -26 (from end of file).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Footer signature 'TRUEVISION-XFILE.\0' at end of file (offset -26).
TGA header: ID length (1), color map type (1), image type (1), color map spec (5), image spec (10).
TGA is used in computer graphics and game development.
